value.zh-CN: 当前选中的值，可 `bind:value`；多选时为数组。不传时由组件自行管理；单向 `value={x}` 只作初值，要完全受控用函数绑定 `bind:value={get, set}`；绑成 `undefined` 会清空选中。没有 defaultValue。
value.en-US: The selected value, supports `bind:value`; an array in multiple mode. Left out, the component manages it; a one-way `value={x}` only seeds it, and for a fully controlled select use the function binding `bind:value={get, set}`. Binding it to `undefined` clears the selection. There is no defaultValue.

expandedKeys.zh-CN: 展开的节点 key，可 `bind:expandedKeys`，展开后显示直接子节点。不传时由组件自行管理；要完全受控用函数绑定 `bind:expandedKeys={get, set}`。没有 defaultExpandedKeys。
expandedKeys.en-US: Keys of the expanded nodes, supports `bind:expandedKeys`; their direct children are displayed. Left out, the component manages them; for fully controlled expansion use the function binding `bind:expandedKeys={get, set}`. There is no defaultExpandedKeys.

loadedKeys.zh-CN: 已加载完成的节点 key，可 `bind:loadedKeys`，与 `loadData` 配合使用。
loadedKeys.en-US: Keys of the nodes that have finished loading, supports `bind:loadedKeys`, used together with `loadData`.

multiple.en-US: Whether several nodes can be selected.

treeData.zh-CN: 节点数据，key 在整棵树内唯一。只有传入新数组才会更新，原地修改数组或节点不会生效。
treeData.en-US: Node data; keys are unique across the tree. Only a new array updates the options, changes made in place are not seen.

keyMaps.zh-CN: 自定义节点中 key、label、value、disabled、children、isLeaf 与 icon 字段的名称。如果自定义了 label 的字段名并开启搜索，需要把 `treeNodeFilterProp` 设为 `treeData` 中的某个字段，或通过 `filterTreeNode` 传入自定义搜索函数。
keyMaps.en-US: Custom names of the key, label, value, disabled, children, isLeaf and icon fields in a node. If you rename the label field and enable search, set `treeNodeFilterProp` to one of the fields in `treeData`, or pass a custom search function to `filterTreeNode`.

treeNodeLabelProp.zh-CN: 显示文本所用的 `TreeNodeData` 属性。
treeNodeLabelProp.en-US: Property of `TreeNodeData` used to display the text.

treeNodeFilterProp.zh-CN: 搜索时匹配的 `TreeNodeData` 属性。

filterTreeNode.zh-CN: 是否可搜索，也可以传入函数自定义搜索逻辑，函数的第三个参数为节点数据 `data`。
filterTreeNode.en-US: Whether the component is searchable, or a function that customizes the search; its third argument is the node data `data`.

showFilteredOnly.zh-CN: 搜索时是否只展示过滤后的结果。
showFilteredOnly.en-US: Whether only the filtered results are displayed while searching.

searchPosition.en-US: Position of the search box: `dropdown` or `trigger`.

searchPlaceholder.zh-CN: 下拉面板中搜索框的占位文本。
searchPlaceholder.en-US: Placeholder of the search box in the dropdown.

searchAutoFocus.zh-CN: 搜索框挂载后是否自动聚焦。
searchAutoFocus.en-US: Whether the search box is focused on mount.

showSearchClear.zh-CN: 下拉面板中的搜索框是否支持清空。
showSearchClear.en-US: Whether the search box in the dropdown can be cleared.

remote.zh-CN: 是否开启远程搜索。开启后输入时不做本地过滤，只触发 `onSearch`，由调用方获取数据并更新 `treeData`。
remote.en-US: Whether remote search is enabled. When enabled, input skips local filtering and only triggers `onSearch`; the caller fetches the data and updates `treeData`.

expandAll.zh-CN: 是否默认展开全部节点。数据（`treeData`）变化后仍受此属性影响。
expandAll.en-US: Whether to expand all nodes by default. The expansion still follows this prop after `treeData` changes.

defaultExpandAll.zh-CN: 初始化时是否展开全部节点。数据（`treeData`）变化后此属性不再生效，需要时使用 `expandAll`。
defaultExpandAll.en-US: Whether to expand all nodes on initialization. After `treeData` changes this prop no longer takes effect; use `expandAll` if you need that.

expandAction.zh-CN: 节点的展开方式，可选 `false`（只有点击展开图标才展开）、`click`、`doubleClick`。
expandAction.en-US: How a node expands: `false` (only the expand icon expands it), `click` or `doubleClick`.

motionExpand.zh-CN: 节点展开和收起时是否带动画。
motionExpand.en-US: Whether expanding and collapsing nodes animates.

loadData.zh-CN: 异步加载子节点，返回 Promise。需要在 `treeData` 中用 `isLeaf` 标明叶子节点。
loadData.en-US: Loads child nodes asynchronously and returns a Promise. Mark leaf nodes with `isLeaf` in `treeData`.

leafOnly.zh-CN: 多选时是否只展示叶子节点的标签，`onChange` 的入参也只包含叶子节点的值。
leafOnly.en-US: In multiple mode, whether only leaf nodes are displayed as tags, and the values passed to `onChange` are leaf nodes only.

checkRelation.zh-CN: 多选时节点选中状态的关系，可选 `related`、`unRelated`。`unRelated` 时节点之间的选中互不影响。
checkRelation.en-US: In multiple mode, the relationship between the checked states of nodes: `related` or `unRelated`. With `unRelated`, the checked states of nodes do not affect each other.

disableStrictly.zh-CN: 严格禁用：节点禁用时，它的选中状态不会因为父或子节点的变化而改变。
disableStrictly.en-US: Strict disabling: when a node is disabled, its checked state cannot be changed through its parent or child nodes.

autoMergeValue.zh-CN: 是否合并值：开启后选中父节点时，值中不包含其后代节点。仅在 `leafOnly` 为 false 时生效。
autoMergeValue.en-US: Whether to merge the value: when on, selecting a parent node keeps its descendants out of the value. Works only when `leafOnly` is false.

onChangeWithObject.zh-CN: `value` 与 `onChange` 的入参是否为节点的全部属性。为 true 时，`value` 与 `onChange` 的值和节点都是节点数据。
onChangeWithObject.en-US: Whether `value` and the arguments of `onChange` carry all properties of the node. When true, the value and the node in `value` and `onChange` are both the node data.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 最多显示的标签数量，超出部分以 +N 的形式展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: Maximum number of tags displayed; the rest are shown as +N.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 标签数量超过 `maxTagCount` 后，hover 到 +N 时是否用 Popover 展示其余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: When the number of tags exceeds `maxTagCount`, whether hovering +N shows the remaining tags in a Popover.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: 超出 `maxTagCount` 后折叠标签的 Popover 配置。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Popover configuration for the collapsed tags beyond `maxTagCount`.

labelEllipsis.zh-CN: 标签溢出时是否省略。未设置时，虚拟化模式下为 true，否则为 false。
labelEllipsis.en-US: Whether labels are truncated with an ellipsis on overflow. Without it, it is true when virtualized and false otherwise.

showLine.zh-CN: 选项面板中的节点是否显示连接线。
showLine.en-US: Whether the nodes in the option panel show connecting lines.

virtualize.zh-CN: 虚拟列表配置，对象包含 `itemSize`（必传，每行的高度）、`height`（下拉高度，建议传数值）与 `width`。虚拟化时动画关闭。
virtualize.en-US: Virtual list configuration: an object with `itemSize` (required, the height of each row), `height` (the height of the dropdown, a number recommended) and `width`. Animation is disabled when virtualized.

size.en-US: Size of the input box: `large`, `small` or `default`.

borderless.en-US: Whether to use the borderless style.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，可选 `warning`、`error`、`default`，只影响组件的背景色。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status: `warning`, `error` or `default`. It only affects the background color of the component.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: `insetLabel` 外层元素的 id，供 `aria-labelledby` 引用。
insetLabelId.en-US: The id of the element around `insetLabel`, for `aria-labelledby` to point at.

showClear.zh-CN: 值不为空时，触发器是否显示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether the trigger shows the clear button when the value is not empty.

clickToHide.zh-CN: 选中后是否自动关闭下拉面板，仅在单选时生效。
clickToHide.en-US: Whether the dropdown closes automatically after a selection; only works in single mode.

clickTriggerToHide.zh-CN: 面板打开时，点击触发器后是否关闭面板。
clickTriggerToHide.en-US: When the panel is open, whether clicking the trigger closes it.

defaultOpen.zh-CN: 挂载时是否打开下拉面板。TreeSelect 没有受控的打开状态，需要关闭时调用 `close()`。
defaultOpen.en-US: Whether the dropdown is open on mount. TreeSelect has no controlled open state; call `close()` to close it.

motion.zh-CN: 下拉面板打开和关闭时是否带动画。
motion.en-US: Whether the dropdown animates in and out.

autoAdjustOverflow.zh-CN: 弹出层被遮挡时是否自动调整方向。
autoAdjustOverflow.en-US: Whether the popup flips its direction automatically when it is covered.

position.zh-CN: 弹出层的位置，可选值参考 Tooltip 的 position，默认 `bottomLeft`（RTL 下为 `bottomRight`）。
position.en-US: Position of the popup; the values follow the position of Tooltip. Defaults to `bottomLeft` (`bottomRight` in RTL).

stopPropagation.zh-CN: 是否阻止下拉面板上的点击事件冒泡。
stopPropagation.en-US: Whether click events on the dropdown panel stop bubbling.

dropdownClassName.en-US: Class name of the dropdown panel.

dropdownStyle.zh-CN: 下拉面板的内联样式字符串。
dropdownStyle.en-US: Inline style string of the dropdown panel.

dropdownMatchSelectWidth.zh-CN: 下拉面板的最小宽度是否与选择框相同。
dropdownMatchSelectWidth.en-US: Whether the minimum width of the dropdown panel matches the width of the select box.

optionListStyle.zh-CN: 选项列表的内联样式字符串，落在 `role="tree"` 元素上。
optionListStyle.en-US: Inline style string of the option list, applied to the `role="tree"` element.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内部调用 `focus` 时是否阻止浏览器滚动文档以显示新聚焦的元素，不作用于用户传入的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the browser avoids scrolling the document to show the newly focused element when the component calls `focus` internally. It does not apply to elements passed in by the user.

triggerTagWrap.zh-CN: 已选标签在触发器内是否允许换行。仅在 `multiple`、开启搜索且 `searchPosition` 为 `trigger` 时生效。
triggerTagWrap.en-US: Whether selected tags wrap onto multiple lines within the trigger. Only works when `multiple` and search are enabled and `searchPosition` is `trigger`.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中值变化时的回调，入参为节点的 value（多选时为数组）、节点数据与事件。关闭标签时事件为 null，键盘选中时为 KeyboardEvent，清空单选时值为 `undefined`。`onChangeWithObject` 为 true 时，值与节点都是节点数据。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selected value changes, with the value of the node (an array in multiple mode), the node data and the event. The event is null when a tag is closed and a KeyboardEvent when a node is selected from the keyboard; clearing a single selection passes `undefined`. With `onChangeWithObject` set to true, the value and the node are both the node data.

onExpand.zh-CN: 展开或收起节点时的回调，入参为展开的 key 数组与 `{ expanded, node }`。
onExpand.en-US: Called when a node expands or collapses, with the array of expanded keys and `{ expanded, node }`.

onLoad.zh-CN: 节点加载完成时的回调。
onLoad.en-US: Called when a node has finished loading.

onSelect.zh-CN: 节点被选中或取消选中时的回调，入参为节点的 key、是否选中与节点数据。
onSelect.en-US: Called when a node is selected or deselected, with the key of the node, whether it is selected, and the node data.

onSearch.zh-CN: 搜索值变化时的回调。入参为搜索值、`filteredExpandedKeys`（因搜索或 value 而展开的节点 key，展开受控时可用于实现搜索展开）与 `filteredNodes`（命中搜索的节点）。
onSearch.en-US: Called when the search value changes, with the search value, `filteredExpandedKeys` (keys of the nodes expanded by the search or by the value, useful when the expansion is controlled) and `filteredNodes` (the nodes that match the search).

onVisibleChange.zh-CN: 下拉面板显示或隐藏时的回调，入参为是否可见。
onVisibleChange.en-US: Called when the dropdown panel is shown or hidden, with whether it is visible.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点从外部进入触发器（包括搜索框与清除按钮）或下拉面板时的回调，入参为原生 FocusEvent；在它们之间移动焦点不会再次触发。选中后关闭下拉，又通过点击或按键重新打开时，同样触发一次，入参为该点击或按键事件；挂载时 `searchAutoFocus` 聚焦的入参为 `null`。
onFocus.en-US: Called when focus enters the trigger (including its search input and clear button) or the dropdown from outside, with the native FocusEvent; moving focus among them does not call it again. Opening again with a click or key after a selection closed the dropdown also calls it, with that click or key event, and the focus `searchAutoFocus` gives on mount passes null.

onBlur.zh-CN: TreeSelect 失去焦点时的回调，每次 onFocus 之后触发一次。焦点离开触发器与下拉时入参为原生 FocusEvent，点击外部时为原生 MouseEvent，选中后关闭下拉时为选中的点击或按键事件。
onBlur.en-US: Called when the TreeSelect loses focus, once after each onFocus. Focus leaving the trigger and the dropdown passes a native FocusEvent, a click outside a native MouseEvent, and selecting a node that closes the dropdown the click or key event of that selection.

onClear.zh-CN: 点击清除按钮时的回调。
onClear.en-US: Called when the clear button is clicked.

label.zh-CN: 自定义节点文本的 snippet，参数 `{ item, label, searchWord }`：节点数据、原文本与搜索词，用法同 Tree 的 `label`。
label.en-US: Snippet for a node's label, receiving `{ item, label, searchWord }`: the node data, the original label and the search word; usage is the same as the `label` of Tree.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义节点图标的 snippet，参数 `{ item, level, expanded, isLeaf, loading, selected, checked, halfChecked }`，用法同 Tree 的 `icon`。
icon.en-US: Snippet for a node's icon, receiving `{ item, level, expanded, isLeaf, loading, selected, checked, halfChecked }`; usage is the same as the `icon` of Tree.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 自定义展开图标的 snippet，参数含 `class`、`onClick` 与 `expanded`，用法同 Tree 的 `expandIcon`；只渲染一个元素时，组件会给它加上展开按钮的类名与点击事件。
expandIcon.en-US: Snippet for the expand icon, receiving `class`, `onClick` and `expanded`; usage is the same as the `expandIcon` of Tree. A single element gets the switcher class and the expand click from the component.

fullLabel.zh-CN: 自定义整行内容的 snippet，外层仍是带 `id`、`role="treeitem"` 与状态属性的行元素，用法同 Tree 的 `fullLabel`。
fullLabel.en-US: Snippet for the content of a whole row, still wrapped in the row element that carries the `id`, `role="treeitem"` and the state attributes; usage is the same as the `fullLabel` of Tree.

selectedItem.zh-CN: 自定义已选项的 snippet，参数 `{ item, index, disabled, onClose }`。单选时内容就是选择框中显示的内容，内容为空时显示 `placeholder`；多选时内容放进内置的 Tag 中，内容为空则不渲染该标签。`onClose` 移除该标签，单选时清除选中值。
selectedItem.en-US: Snippet for the selected items, receiving `{ item, index, disabled, onClose }`. In single mode its content is what the select box shows, and `placeholder` shows when it is empty; in multiple mode its content goes into the built-in Tag, and an empty content renders no tag. `onClose` removes the tag, or clears the single selection.

tag.zh-CN: 多选时替换整个标签的 snippet，参数同 `selectedItem`，优先于 `selectedItem`。需要关闭按钮时把 `onClose` 接到自己的 Tag 上。
tag.en-US: Snippet that replaces each tag in multiple mode, with the same parameters as `selectedItem` and ahead of it. To get a close button, wire `onClose` to your own Tag.

trigger.zh-CN: 替换触发器内容的 snippet，参数含 `value`（已选节点的数据）、`inputValue`、`placeholder`、`disabled`、`componentProps`（传给 TreeSelect 的全部属性）、`onSearch`（更新搜索词，需要 `filterTreeNode` 且 `searchPosition` 为 `trigger`）、`onClear`（绑在触发器内的控件上时传入点击事件，避免同时打开下拉）与 `onRemove`（以节点 key 取消勾选）。
trigger.en-US: Snippet that replaces the trigger content. Its parameters are `value` (the data of the selected nodes), `inputValue`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `componentProps` (all the props given to TreeSelect), `onSearch` (updates the search keyword; needs `filterTreeNode` and a `searchPosition` of `trigger`), `onClear` (pass the click event when bound to a control inside the trigger, so the click does not open the dropdown) and `onRemove` (unchecks the node with the key).

search.zh-CN: 替换搜索框的 snippet，参数带有 ARIA 属性（`aria-activedescendant`、`aria-controls`、`aria-autocomplete`、名称；搜索框在触发器内时为整组 combobox 属性）、`class`、`value`、`placeholder`、`showClear`、`onChange(value)` 等，请用 `{...props}` 展开到 Semi 的 Input 上。传 `false` 时不渲染搜索框，`filterTreeNode` 仍会过滤。
search.en-US: Snippet that replaces the search box. Its parameters carry the ARIA attributes (`aria-activedescendant`, `aria-controls`, `aria-autocomplete`, the name; the whole combobox set while the search box is in the trigger), `class`, `value`, `placeholder`, `showClear`, `onChange(value)` and so on; spread them with `{...props}` onto a Semi Input. `false` renders no search box, while `filterTreeNode` still filters.

prefix.zh-CN: 选择框前面内容的 snippet。
prefix.en-US: Snippet for the content in front of the select box.

suffix.zh-CN: 选择框后面内容的 snippet。
suffix.en-US: Snippet for the content after the select box.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 选择框内标签的 snippet，同时作为下拉树的名称。设置 `prefix` 时不渲染，也不作为可访问名称。
insetLabel.en-US: Snippet for a label inside the select box, which also names the dropdown tree. It is not rendered, and does not name the component, when `prefix` is used.

arrowIcon.zh-CN: 自定义右侧下拉箭头图标的 snippet，传 `null` 不显示箭头。`showClear` 开启且有已选值时，hover 优先显示清除图标。
arrowIcon.en-US: Snippet for the dropdown arrow icon on the right; `null` shows no arrow. With `showClear` on and a value selected, hovering shows the clear icon first.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 自定义清除按钮图标的 snippet，`showClear` 为 true 时有效。
clearIcon.en-US: Snippet for the icon of the clear button, effective when `showClear` is true.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 无数据或搜索无结果时的空状态内容的 snippet，未设置时显示语言包中的文案；传 `null` 时不显示。
emptyContent.en-US: Snippet for the empty state shown when there is no data or the search finds no result. Without it the locale text is shown; `null` hides it.

outerTopSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉面板顶部的 snippet，与选项列表同级。开启 `filterTreeNode` 时它会替代搜索框，需要自定义搜索时可以通过 `bind:this` 的 `search` 方法实现。
outerTopSlot.en-US: Snippet rendered at the top of the dropdown panel, at the same level as the option list. With `filterTreeNode` on, it replaces the search box; to customize the search, use the `search` method through `bind:this`.

outerBottomSlot.zh-CN: 渲染在下拉面板底部的 snippet，与选项列表同级。
outerBottomSlot.en-US: Snippet rendered at the bottom of the dropdown panel, at the same level as the option list.

search.zh-CN: 按输入了该值来搜索，先打开下拉面板，需要同时设置 `filterTreeNode`。
search.en-US: Searches as if the value were typed, opening the dropdown first. Needs `filterTreeNode`.
